gui.ore_distribution_scanner.title: Ore distribution
gui.ore_distribution_scanner.empty_subte: No distribution data for the %s yet.
gui.ore_distribution_scanner.footer_popu: Hover a depth layer for exact numbers. Use the arrows to switch biome.
gui.ore_distribution_scanner.footer_empt: Stand in the dimension you want to map, then run the command.
message.ore_distribution_scanner.ore_lis: Ore Distribution Scanner: the ore whitelist/blacklist changed. Rejoin (singleplayer) or reconnect (multiplayer) to apply the ore list changes.
config.ore_distribution_scanner.title: Ore Distribution Scanner
config.ore_distribution_scanner.scan_rad: Radius in chunks of the spread sample around the scan origin.
config.ore_distribution_scanner.biome_cl: Chunks sampled in a small cluster around each located biome position.
config.ore_distribution_scanner.chunk_bu: Maximum number of chunks sampled in a single scan.
config.ore_distribution_scanner.progress: How often scan progress is posted to the command sender.
config.ore_distribution_scanner.low_conf: Biome views below this many sampled chunks are flagged low-confidence.
config.ore_distribution_scanner.scan_per: Permission level required for /ods scan, cancel, clear, and reload. Default 0 means any player can use them with no cheats; raise it to restrict these to operators.
config.ore_distribution_scanner.ore_whit: Extra block ids to count as ores. Changing this needs a rejoin to apply.
config.ore_distribution_scanner.ore_blac: Block ids to exclude even if an ore tag includes them. Changing this needs a rejoin to apply.
